feature: Endpoint backend POST /v1/datahive/query (+ /query/custom, /query/async) yang menjalankan SQL mentah ke DataHive
note: Endpoint generik menerima SQL dari request body dan menjalankannya di DataHive; tidak ada UI atau proxy dari ocmsadminapi. Paling dekat dengan OCMS40.1-40.3 tetapi bukan alur officer. Perlu cek keamanan akses (tidak ada otorisasi per pengguna yang terlihat di controller).
note_en: Generic endpoint that takes SQL from the request body and runs it on DataHive; no UI or proxy from ocmsadminapi. Closest to OCMS40.1-40.3 but not an officer flow. Access control needs checking (no per-user authorization is visible in the controller).

note: Controller berkomentar 'Remove this controller after testing'; mengambil data NRIC/FIN/UEN per ID + noticeNumber. Bukan fitur produk; sebaiknya tidak diklaim dan dipertimbangkan untuk dihapus.
note_en: Controller commented 'Remove this controller after testing'; fetches NRIC/FIN/UEN data per ID + noticeNumber. Not a product feature; should not be claimed and removal should be considered.

feature: Unclaimed reminder memasukkan current offender ke ocms_adhoc_nro_temp untuk batch MHA/DataHive, dan job UEN/FIN membaca tabel itu
note: Pencarian ID 'ad-hoc' lewat antrean ocms_adhoc_nro_temp (juga dari HST monthly query, CronProxyController.java:306). Bukan query ad-hoc officer ala Epic40 dan mungkin sudah dicakup story Unclaimed Reminder/HST; belum dicocokkan ke story lain.
note_en: 'Ad-hoc' ID lookup through the ocms_adhoc_nro_temp queue (also filled by the HST monthly query, CronProxyController.java:306). Not an Epic40-style officer ad-hoc query and may already be covered by the Unclaimed Reminder/HST stories; not matched to other stories.
